Claim all for the news.** When two or more live entries are unclaimed, `NewsList` (`apps/web/src/routes/NewsPanel.tsx`) shows a **Claim all** button above the list. It claims every unclaimed entry through the existing `POST /api/news/:newsId/claim`, one at a time, newest first, each a spend with its own Idempotency-Key as today (R2875000, R2124000, R2378000). Do not add a server route. Entries as cards.** Each news entry is currently a bare column of title, summary, reward and button (`account-quests__quest`, styled in `routes/account.css` and `routes/landing.css`). Put the card's styles under one shared class in one place (e.g. `account-quests__quest` itself, or a new `entry-card` in a CSS file both panels import) instead of copying them between `landing.css` and `account.css`. It has to read on the landing's parchment and on `/collection`'s tavern shell, in light and dark, and at phone width (360px) with no horizontal scroll.
